geo.note: Geo anchors for picking a start point from GPS. Coordinates are approximate; the venue map is schematic. Sources: OpenStreetMap building ways 33149360 (Salt Palace Convention Center) and 1150797303 (Hyatt Regency Salt Lake City), and the OSM street centrelines of 200 South, 100 South, West Temple, 200 West and 300 West. Footprint is the two buildings combined, simplified.
